findings.claim: Scope 1: Gold's swung between minus 0.29 and 0.49.
findings.evidence: Recomputed from raw files: 52 windows ending 2022-01 to 2026-04; gold min -0.294234 (2025-10), max 0.492969 (2024-03), matching results.json to 3e-16; the line crosses zero once (2024-09 to 2024-10) and sh-4 shows the path.

findings.claim: Scope 2: The S&P 500's and Bitcoin's monthly averages are taken over each month's S&P 500 trading days; gold's is the World Bank's monthly average.
findings.evidence: build_analysis.py:287-291 averages the S&P 500 and Bitcoin over each month's S&P 500 trading days; :292 takes gold's World Bank monthly value unchanged (reindex); recompute matches; the sentence neither states nor contradicts the inclusion rule.

findings.claim: Scope 3: [[published] alt:sh-2-safe-haven-test.png] Thick horizontal bars mark the averages and thin vertical bars their 95% confidence intervals.
findings.evidence: make_charts.py:126 hlines lw=3 (average) and :127 vlines lw=2 (95% CI), strip() for all three panels (:148, :154); PNG shows thick horizontal bars at -4.4, -13.1, -0.5 and thin vertical interval bars.

findings.claim: Scope 4: [[published] alt:sh-3-episodes.png] Horizontal bar chart of Bitcoin's and the S&P 500's largest fall between the S&P 500's high and its low, in the three S&P 500 falls of 15% or more since 2020.
findings.evidence: make_charts.py:176 loops over sp500 and bitcoin only and the legend shows only those two; bars are max_fall(prices.loc[peak:trough]) (build_analysis.py:274-275); exactly three falls of 15% or more (33.92, 25.43, 18.90%; next 9.60%), still true through 2026-10-09.

findings.claim: Scope 5: [[published] alt:sh-3-episodes.png] Bitcoin fell further in each: 49 percent against 34 across the 24 S&P 500 closes from the 2020 fall's high to its low, 61 against 25 across the 196 closes of the 2022 fall, and 22 against 19 across the 35 of the 2025 fall.
findings.evidence: Recomputed: 24/196/35 S&P closes high to low inclusive; Bitcoin 48.88 v 33.93, 61.01 v 25.43, 22.40 v 18.90 on those S&P dates; 'the 2020 fall's high' can only be 2020-02-19, curing r6:item:5.
